'''Oversized cards''' are Decipher Star Wars CCG premiums printed larger than the 63×88&nbsp;mm playing card. The 5×7 show premiums were given for spending $20 at the Decipher convention store, or packed as [[Reflections]] box toppers. Magazine inserts include an InQuest [[Princess Leia Organa]] (about 3.5×5 with a punch-out miniature) and a Scrye [[Boba Fett]] sticker. InQuest also inserted an undersized [[R'kik D'nec, Hero Of The Dune Sea]] punch-out. Normal-size tournament foils are listed at [[Promotional Foils]], and [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]] covers Mara Jade's two 5×7s in depth.<ref name="bgg-42">[https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/33565/star-wars-ccg-complete-card-list-42 Star Wars CCG Complete Card List 4.2], Whaleyland, BoardGameGeek (22 August 2012). Oversized: Hunt Down & Destroy the Jedi and Mind What You Have Learned (Reflections I box toppers); Aurra Sing, Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand, and Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde (spend $20 or more at Decipher Store at conventions); Princess Leia Organa (InQuest magazine insert).</ref>

All but one are different-size versions of regular cards: [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]], [[Aurra Sing (AI)]], [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]], [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]], [[Princess Leia Organa]], [[Boba Fett]], and [[R'kik D'nec, Hero Of The Dune Sea]]. The exception is the group 5×7 [[Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde]], which has no regular-size version.

[[File:Oversized Mara Jade The Emperor's Hand scale.jpg|thumb|right|320px|5×7 [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] with the regular-size [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] card.<ref name="ccg-collector">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frvqLMqMc14 Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards], The CCG Collector (29 November 2015). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-frvqLMqMc14 Internet Archive].</ref>]]

All you need to know!], BoardMatt (19 June 2022). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-5q_ufwHceDM Internet Archive].</ref>]]

Three 5×7 show premiums were given for spending $20 at the Decipher store at conventions:<ref name="bgg-42" />

* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] (copyright 2000). Same photograph and game text as the [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] premium. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11259 (Duncan Jenkins, 5×7, year 2000).<ref name="swca-11259">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11259 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand], Star Wars Collectors Archive.</ref>
* [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] (copyright 2001). [[Michonne Bourriague]] portrayed Aurra Sing for Decipher. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11258.<ref name="swca-11258">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11258 Premium Oversize Card, Aurra Sing], Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130621135247/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11258 Wayback, 21 June 2013].</ref>
* [[Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde|''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde'']] (copyright 2001). Destiny 3, Power 8, Ability 5, Deploy 8, Forfeit 9, Pilot and Warrior, Force-Sensitive. Lore: "Each driven by a dubious past, these scoundrels now plan for the greater good of the New Republic. Found in the strangest places." The game-text box is blank. Back: Rebel Alliance symbol, decipher.com, starwars.com. Star Wars Collectors Archive item 11260.<ref name="swca-11260">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130621235647/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Wayback, 21 June 2013].</ref>

[[File:Oversized Aurra Sing signed.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Aurra Sing (AI)]] 5×7 signed by [[Michonne Bourriague]].<ref name="cat1-aurra">[https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-misc_sw_items/aurra_sing_oversized_signed_by_michonne_bourriague/97511 Aurra Sing oversized signed by Michonne Bourriague], CategoryOne Games. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009205235/https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-misc_sw_items/aurra_sing_oversized_signed_by_michonne_bourriague/97511 Wayback, 9 October 2026].</ref>]]
[[File:Oversized Mara Jade Corran Horn Talon Karrde signed.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Group 5×7 signed by Baksa, Stackpole and Zahn.]]

Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001), reported the next day by Yarua on TheForce.net: Decipher would make the group card available at Origins, San Diego Comic-Con, GenCon, Wizard World, and DragonCon so fans could get autographs from Shannon Baksa (Mara Jade), Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn), and Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde). "No Game Text (you'll need room for autographs!)" The three had been shot together when Decipher photographed the individual [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] cards.<ref name="tfn-rfd">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Yaruas_RFD_Report_622628_72011.asp Yarua's RFD Report (6.22–6.28)], TheForce.net (23 June 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150215035122/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/yaruas_rfd_report_622628_72011.asp Wayback, 15 February 2015].</ref>

== Reflections I box toppers ==

Each [[Reflections]] display included one of two 5×7 double-sided objective cards. They are promotional and are not part of the 114 pack foils.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Wayback, 9 October 2026].</ref>

== Convention booth displays ==
Decipher hung oversized card images with velcro tabs on booth walls at Gen Con, Origins and the GAMA trade show. Surviving pieces include a roughly 2 ft × 2 ft [[Collision]] and an oversized [[Chewbacca]] that came from [[Jim Colson]].<ref name="talaga-weird">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dR5MIPH4h4 Star Wars CCG - Most Interesting and Strangest Things in Our Collections with Special Guest Andy], [[BoardMatt]] with [[Andy Talaga]] (29 May 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220529152129/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dR5MIPH4h4 Internet Archive]; [https://archive.org/details/youtube-4dR5MIPH4h4 Internet Archive item].</ref> Colson kept vinyl velcro booth cards from those walls, including a Death Star and Chewbacca.<ref name="colson-velcro">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1182s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], [[BoardMatt]], YouTube (24 April 2022), at 19:42. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174310/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o Internet Archive]</ref>
